substantive_delta: The position-sum witness now has a full rational no-CCRA proof with arbitrary finite control, arbitrary rational constants, nonlinear copyless updates and any finite register count. A minimum-rank retraction preserves the minimal observable subquotient despite singular physical maps. The commuting-unipotent obstruction and a finite-control return-block transfer recovering the entire minimal algebra then characterize CCRA realizability throughout the all-word-unipotent minimal rational sector. This yields constructive polynomial-bit membership for explicit scattered-pattern sums. Known commutativity, minimization, trace and counter constructions are credited rather than claimed as new.
why_nonroutine: Neither unary pumping restrictions nor monomial diagonal-block covers rule out the noncommuting unitriangular witness. The proof must normalize singular nonlinear maps and retain both invariant spaces of the observable quotient. Finite control is eliminated by common return blocks, polynomial roots and an actual unit prefix, with a proof that the generated algebra and both minimality spans are retained. The inspected primary results do not provide this realizability transfer; a bounded current search found no equivalent resolution. This is a reasoned novelty assessment, not an exhaustive priority certificate.
significance: The result settles the exact source sufficiency question using its proposed rational witness and identifies a structural obstacle invisible to all uniform unary pumping sequences. The extension replaces an isolated separation by an infinite-sector characterization and an effective realization decision with explicit positive constructions and short negative witnesses for a natural pattern-count input class. This is substantive automata expressiveness and realizability value; no claim of venue quality or acceptance is made.
